# Plugin export fixture

`plugin-linux-path.tar.gz` was generated by the OpenClaw plugin's
`transfer-current-path.test.ts` using `exportFullArchive` (schema v2).
It contains only synthetic `report\draft.txt` content and an empty cron list.
`TestPluginLinuxPathArchive` imports it by default on POSIX; no environment
variable is required. `TRANSFER_PATH_FIXTURE` can override it for manual
cross-repository verification.
